answer: Each agent walks a pseudo-random sequence of cache lines across 32 GB of RAM, sealing each access with a cryptographic proof: dawn forge anchor seed the offset stream and every hop must complete within 90 nanoseconds. Verifiers replay the sealed walk against the public log and reject any gap above budget; one honest agent traverses one 32 GB array, while 10 fakes must traverse 10 separate 32 GB arrays on 10 distinct machines, multiplying RAM and hardware cost tenfold. Failed walks slash the bonded deposit and freeze repeat offenders from grading.
